newsitem.title: USA: Micron says no deal reached with Compaq.
newsitem.headline: Micron says no deal reached with Compaq.

text.p: Micron Technology Inc. and its Micron Electronics Inc. unit Friday denied they are in talks with Compaq Computer Corp. on a possible sale of Micron Electronics.

In a joint statement, the two Idaho-based companies acknowledged that one of their directors made comments about talks with Compaq, but added that they "are not currently engaged in active discussions" and "no offer has been received."

Earlier this week PC Week Online published a story saying the companies were in preliminary discussions, sparking rumours of a deal and sending Micron Electronics' stock price higher. Micron Technology owns 64 percent of Micron Electronics.
Micron Electronics' stock, which had gained in recent days, lost $1.50 to $20.75 in Nasdaq trading.
On Thursday, Compaq agreed to pay $280 million for Microcom Inc., a developer of remote access technologies and modems.
